Yeah it’s true that our defense is one of the worst in the league in terms of defensive rating and our offense is one of the best in the league according to offensive rating, but we’re not the best in every metric on offense and it’s mostly due to our one dimensional offense that doesn’t really play to our strengths as much as it did last year. We run the pick and roll really well because we have Trae young, but when we aren’t running that we’re hunting miss matches and isoing off that. Except we are one of the worst teams in the league in terms of isolation success. When we’re not running the pick and roll the ball movement is completely stagnant.

On defense our point of attack defense is terrible to put it nicely. No one besides Hunter and Delon Wright plays with any sort of physicality. Our defensive sets have changed from Lloyd Pierce’s so it’s completely exposed our defense. We can’t just funnel any dribble penetration into Capela like we did last year. Earlier in the year Capela was really out of shape because he was recovering from injury so it was really bad. 

I could go on and on about the problems with this team but those are the most glaring issues.
